data.title: 宝多六花 · 哥哥住处的漫画借阅
data.description: 周末，她盘腿坐在哥哥公寓的书架前翻漫画，头发随意别到耳后，手边放着借来的罐装咖啡；被哥哥念叨时头也不抬地敷衍，是兄妹间松弛的日常。
data.action: 盘腿翻看借来的漫画，将一侧头发别到耳后。
data.promptProse: Rikka Takarada sits cross-legged before the bookshelf in her brother's apartment, hair tucked casually behind one ear as she reads borrowed manga. A canned coffee rests within reach beside her grey hoodie and relaxed dark trousers. She responds to his off-frame remarks without lifting her eyes. The horizontal medium view includes low shelves and the open book. Daylight illuminates the pages and can rim, with deeper recesses behind the packed book spines.
